svg.title: Every Strike integration in EdgeCraft-StrikeCity: 46 endpoints in six areas
svg.text: 46 endpoints in use · six integrations · mainnet and testnet

g.text: called by the site's Functions, at onboarding
One wallet signature creates an agent on the user's own
Strike account. Before saving anything, the site checks
that Strike linked exactly our key, our builder code
SmartFlowAgent-EdgeCraft and 20 bps. If anything differs,
the key is burnt and the attempt is recorded.

svg.text: Revenue: 0.20 % per strategy execution, credited by
Strike to the builder (copies pay none). Funds never
leave the user's account, and the user approves the

g.text: called by every agent on the host · Ed25519-signed
Every order a strategy places carries the builder fee,
so each execution is credited to our builder code.
called by the collector (read only) and the copy pilot
Collector: no keys, history kept beyond Strike's 30 days.
Pilot: a free sub-account of yours, or a new one only when
none fits; Strike enforces the stop-loss. No fee to us.
Traders' names, badges and positions: /v2/account and
/v2/positions; Hyperliquid's public API for its traders.
Market data, live in the city
read straight from the browser (news: on the host)
Every car is a real trade on Strike. The towers carry
TradingView's live chart of their market, and Strike
Finance's building STRIKE, its own token (Cardano),
through DEX Screener: TradingView has no chart of it.
read inside the Strike Finance building · /stat/v1
Volume, users, TVL, open interest, revenue and funding,
live, as nobody shows them on Strike today.
Into Strike's app, and our checks
links for everyone · checks before every release
from every user and every agent
